collections.name: RC Contract
collections.description: The public --rc-* styling contract consumed by rc-webcomponents. Aliases the theme layer, so swapping the theme reskins every component.

textStyles.name: Windows 3.1/body
textStyles.family: 'Microsoft Sans Serif', 'MS Sans Serif', Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

effectStyles.name: Bevel/bevel-inset-1
effectStyles.value: inset var(--win31-hairline) var(--win31-hairline) 0 var(--win31-color-shadow), inset calc(-1 * var(--win31-hairline)) calc(-1 * var(--win31-hairline)) 0 var(--win31-color-highlight)

effectStyles.name: Bevel/bevel-outset-1
effectStyles.value: inset var(--win31-hairline) var(--win31-hairline) 0 var(--win31-color-highlight), inset calc(-1 * var(--win31-hairline)) calc(-1 * var(--win31-hairline)) 0 var(--win31-color-shadow)

effectStyles.name: Bevel/dialog-frame
effectStyles.value: inset 0 0 0 calc(3 * var(--win31-hairline)) var(--win31-color-title-active), inset 0 0 0 calc(4 * var(--win31-hairline)) var(--win31-color-highlight)
